VBO:0200552.summary: Hardy and persistent in pursuit, French White and Orange Hounds work in packs to hunt deer and roe deer. The French kennel club describes meticulous trackers with fine noses and strong voices, able to sustain several hours of pursuit at a good pace.
VBO:0200552.shortDescription: Hardy French pack hounds, described as meticulous trackers with fine noses, strong voices and sustained deer-hunting work.
